evals.name: Title Synchronization, SEO Meta & Canonical URL Stripping
evals.prompt: Configure SeoService and AppTitleStrategy in an Angular SPA to dynamically manage page titles, Open Graph tags, and canonical links stripped of tracking query parameters.
evals.expected_output: Implements AppTitleStrategy extending TitleStrategy with centralized title formatting, and SeoService with setMetaTags() and setCanonicalUrl() stripping query parameters from canonical tags.
assertions: Implements AppTitleStrategy extending TitleStrategy with centralized title template
Implements SeoService with setMetaTags for description, OG tags, and Twitter cards
Strips tracking query parameters from canonical URL links in setCanonicalUrl
Uses inject(DOCUMENT) and inject(Meta) with strict typing

evals.name: GA4 Route Navigation Telemetry & AdSense CLS Protection
evals.prompt: Implement GA4 client route tracking on NavigationEnd events and an AdSense component preventing Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS).
evals.expected_output: Creates AnalyticsService listening to Router NavigationEnd events with gtag('config'), and standalone AdsenseComponent reserving min-height: 250px container.
assertions: Subscribes to Router.events filtering NavigationEnd to send page_view via gtag
Guards window and gtag execution with isPlatformBrowser(platformId)
Reserves min-height: 250px container in AdsenseComponent to eliminate CLS penalties
Enforces strict TypeScript typing with zero explicit any annotations

evals.name: Cloudflare Pages Fallback, ads.txt & Standalone Legal Policies
evals.prompt: Setup Cloudflare Pages SPA client-side fallback routing (_redirects), Google AdSense authorization (ads.txt), and standalone Privacy Policy and Terms of Service components.
evals.expected_output: Provides public/_redirects with '/* /index.html 200', public/ads.txt with publisher ID, and standalone PrivacyPolicyComponent and TermsOfServiceComponent for AdSense compliance.
assertions: Deploys public/ads.txt with authorized publisher ID
Implements standalone PrivacyPolicyComponent disclosing GA4 and AdSense DART cookies
Registers keyword-rich titles for /privacy and /terms routes
